newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel demolishes four Arab homes in Hebron.
newsitem.headline: Israel demolishes four Arab homes in Hebron.

text.p: Israeli soldiers demolished four Palestinian homes in the West Bank town of Hebron on Monday, saying they had been constructed illegally, witnesses said.
The houses were located near the Jewish settlement of Kiryat Arba in Hebron, in an area still under Israeli occupation.
"The soldiers have demolished four houses...and told the families the reason was because they had no building permits," one witness said.
The Israeli army said it was checking the report.
Since 1993, Israel has demolished more than 120 Arab homes in the West Bank and East Jerusalem, human rights groups say.
Israel handed over 80 percent of Hebron to the Palestinian Authority in January under Israel-PLO peace deals.

On Monday, around 200 Palestinians demonstrated in front of the Red Cross building in Hebron demanding the release of Doctor Samir al-Qadi, director of al-Ahli hospital arrested by Israel in the village of Sourif near Hebron last month.
Israel lifted on Sunday a curfew in force in Sourif since a resident killed himself and three Israeli women in a bombing at a Tel Aviv cafe on March 21.
